encoding_note: C1–C8 encode the standing authorization, closed actions, and locked product states named by the master control-plane upload, checked against this main. They are company program gates for this governance branch. They are not the Optics architecture gates in docs/architecture/optics-foundation/09-IMPLEMENTATION-GATES.md, and a LOCKED or RULE state is not a production pass.

gates.name: Governance path
gates.rule: This program's files stay under docs/programs/production-readiness/.

gates.name: Reversible docs merge
gates.rule: Standing authorization allows merge of reversible docs when the docs-only path check passes and repository checks are green.
gates.satisfied_by_this_force: Evaluated on the pull request. It does not authorize an implementation merge.

gates.name: CLI freeze
gates.rule: @vantio/cli stays 0.3.24. This program does not patch, republish, or retag it.

gates.name: Python transition
gates.rule: Source and PyPI both name vantio-agent-sdk 3.1.0. This program does not publish, yank, or announce.

gates.name: Merged contract source
gates.rule: PKG-01 and PKG-02 Unit A are merged source. Live writer integration stays outside this program.

gates.name: Phantom Engine docs channel
gates.rule: Phantom Engine customer documents require a private channel. Public main is an incompatible merge target. This tree keeps governance references and omits confidential bodies.

gates.name: Publish closed
gates.rule: This program does not publish to npm, PyPI, a GitHub release, or an external diligence room.

gates.name: Category boundary
gates.rule: Optics observes. Phantom Engine is Enforce + Control in its own repository. Enterprise is governance on that protection. This program does not move a capability across those categories.
